reason: I never understood these bills. If the landlord starts the fight, the landlord pays his own lawyers.
Better to agree the budget first than fight afterwards. Fewer rows, fewer lawyers.
If the leaseholder is wrong, why should the landlord pay? Loser pays is fair, and small landlords need protecting.
Flat owners get billed for things they can't see. The one sending the bill should pay for the argument.
Whoever loses pays. That's how it's always worked and it keeps people honest.
Let the people who live there look at the budget before the bill comes. Prevention beats a fight.
Loser pays stops silly challenges. Small landlords need the safe harbour.
Fair to both sides. Small landlords can't afford endless disputes, but bad claims shouldn't be free.
Landlords hold all the money and the lawyers. Renters and owners alike get squeezed. They should pay their own way.
Simple. You send the bill, you fund the fight. No small print.
I rent, but I've seen mates stung by fees. Make the landlord carry it.
I'd rather have a say before I'm billed than argue later when I'm ill and worn out.
